Adenomatoid Odontogenic Tumor: The presence of a unicystic radiolucent area with clear boundaries, the association with an ectopic tooth, and the histological features of whorled masses of spindle cells, sheets, and plexiform strands, along with the presence of duct-like structures and calcification, are characteristic of an Adenomatoid Odontogenic Tumor.

The clinical context of an ectopic tooth and a cystic lesion also supports this diagnosis.
